reason: Conversation 1 correctly reads the cold freezer, warm fridge, heavy frost and weak vent airflow as an iced evaporator from a defrost-system fault. It gives a full 24-48h manual defrost with safe advice (no chipping, no heat guns), says to expect recurrence and treats the defrost parts as suspects rather than confirmed, so it holds off on part purchases. It also points to an engineer if the frost returns. Conversation 2 fixates on the defrost drain, sends the customer hunting for a hole that is hidden on frost-free models, suggests a 24h door-shut wait that does nothing for iced coils, asks low-value repeated checks, and never proposes a manual defrost or escalation.
